summary: Iteration 4 testing — X-Owner-Key isolation + fully editable notes. Backend: 13/13 pytest passed (test_owner_isolation.py). Fixed one MongoDB _id serialization bug in POST /api/pdf/parse (motor's insert_one mutates the doc adding ObjectId, which broke the JSON response). Frontend: verified DEVICE_ID stored in localStorage under 'gc_device_id', axios X-Owner-Key header sent on all /api/* requests, device-id-badge shows 'registro personale • dispositivo <first-8-chars>', per-device isolation confirmed (clearing localStorage produces empty list), full note editability confirmed (textarea editable, manual indicator, TS/TC/D/A/MONO/INT/PTE-EST fields under 'Modifica campi' live-update textarea, Salva nota, Rigenera dai campi restores text).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /pdf/parse previously passed the same dict reference to motor.insert_one AND to the response list; motor mutates the dict with _id (ObjectId) causing 500 on JSON serialization. Fixed by inserting a copy (dict(doc)) so response stays clean. Consider using a helper like insert_and_get(clean_dict) across the codebase to avoid re-introduction.

PATCH /notes/{id} returns the fetched doc after in-place merge; because _authorize_note reads with projection {_id: 0} this is safe, but a similar bug pattern exists — a future refactor risks passing the returned doc into $set without projection. Consider always doing db.notes.find_one_and_update with return_document=AFTER + projection.

regenerate_note_text uses defaults like 'TS','TC','D','A','MONO','INT' — legacy notes without these fields will show placeholder tokens. This is intentional per spec (user-editable) but worth documenting.
test_credentials: None required (no auth in this app).
seed_data_creation: Backend test fixture created 4+4 notes under owner_keys DEV-A-iter4-test and DEV-B-iter4-test, all cleaned up via bulk-delete at end of module. No stray data (verified: GET /api/notes without header returns 0).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 4 fully passed. Backend fix committed in server.py line ~342: dict(doc) before insert_one to prevent motor mutation adding ObjectId. Regression suite: /app/backend/tests/test_owner_isolation.py + previous tests test_bulk_delete.py, test_files_endpoint.py. Frontend note UI has editable <textarea data-testid='note-preview-<wr>'>, structured fields under 'Modifica campi' toggle with data-testid='field-<key>-<wr>'.
rca of the issue: Bug: POST /api/pdf/parse returned 500 when returning newly-created notes. RCA: motor's insert_one mutates the supplied dict by inserting _id: ObjectId(...). The same dict reference was appended to created_notes then returned by FastAPI → jsonable_encoder fails on ObjectId. Fix: pass a shallow copy `dict(doc)` to insert_one so the response list retains a clean dict without _id.
